# InvestAA

> InvestAA is an online investment platform where users can create accounts, manage portfolios, make deposits and withdrawals, and access VIP investment tiers.

## Public Pages

- [Login](/login.html): Sign in to your InvestAA account.
- [Register](/register.html): Create a new InvestAA account.
- [Forgot Password](/forgot-password.html): Reset your account password.
- [Verify Account](/verify.html): Complete account email or identity verification.
- [Support](/support.html): Contact InvestAA customer support.
- [Help](/help.html): Frequently asked questions and platform guidance.

## Notes

- Authenticated dashboard, wallet, deposit, withdrawal, transfer, KYC, admin, and VIP pages require a logged-in session and are not intended for crawling.
- For crawling permissions, refer to `/robots.txt`.
- For a structured list of public URLs, refer to `/sitemap.xml`.
